notes.r-p7-04:0: Key D guarantees (word changed from 'carry', which another set tests). Near-correct B protects: the most common sense of secure (make safe), and 'protects your date' reads acceptably in the sentence; excluded because the paragraph is a booking policy (Please book at least ten days in advance) and the deposit makes the date certain, not safe from harm. C obtains is a real sense (secure funding) but needs a person as subject, not 'A deposit'; A fastens is the physical sense. Evidence: web page para 3. Self band medium (L, B).
notes.r-p7-04:1: Key B to order catering for a staff event (options re-leveled to 6-7 words). Near-correct A report a change of office address: the move to Ashby is stated plainly in para 1 (Please note ...) but is only a side note; D give a final number of guests is tempting because numbers are discussed, but para 2 says the exact number will come later. Evidence: e-mail paras 1-3. 'Ms.' is supported by the invoice head (Attn: Ms. Dana Whitfield). Self band medium (L, D).
notes.r-p7-04:2: Key A more main dishes than in January (key trimmed to 8 words). Near-correct C same package as in January (superseded: e-mail para 1 praises the Harvest Package, para 2 asks for dessert+coffee, which only the Banquet Package has). Evidence: e-mail paras 1-2 + web page para 2 (Banquet = Harvest + second hot main) + invoice row 1 ($26). Self band hard (L, D, B, S).
notes.r-p7-04:3: Key C new office outside the free-delivery area (was 'no-charge zone'). Lure A changed from 'held on a weekend' (it gave away the inference Q5 needs) to 'added coffee service to its order': the e-mail asks for coffee, which sounds like an add-on, but coffee service is part of the Banquet Package already priced at $26 per guest, and the $35 line is labelled Delivery. B (food by a set time) is a real request with no fee attached; D contradicted by the dates (17+ days ahead). Evidence: invoice row 2 + web page para 3 + e-mail para 1. Self band hard (L, D, B, S), lower edge.
notes.r-p7-04:4: Key D two days later than first proposed (all four options now one shape, 8-9 words). Near-correct A on the date first proposed (superseded: Thursday, March 20; the invoice's Event line gives no date); B final count fell short of the estimate (direction: invoice bills 34, the policy bills the final count); C builders' promised finish date (neighbouring date, March 18). Evidence: invoice row 3 $60 Staffing + web page para 3 ($60 = Saturday/Sunday) + e-mail para 3 (fallback Saturday, March 22). Self band hard (L, D, B, S).
notes.r-p7-05:0: Key C announce changes to a trip (trimmed to 6 words). Revision: B is now 'To explain a refund policy', drawn from e-mail para 4 (cancel for a full refund, move tours, voucher), the last and a long paragraph, so it is locally tempting; it is wrong because the offer exists only because of the changes in paras 2-3, applies only to those who do not travel, and is a one-off offer until June 12, not a policy. D apologize for a late departure uses the review's event, which happened after the e-mail date. Para 1 is neutral, so the purpose comes from paras 2-3. Self band medium (L, D); blind review had judged the old version easy.
notes.r-p7-05:1: Key A remains valid. Revision: C is now 'is on hold' (stand = be left untouched, as in 'let it stand'), which reads correctly in 'This offer ___ until 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 12'; it is excluded only by the previous sentence (you may cancel ... or move ... = available now). D 'is displayed' (a thing stands on a shelf) also fits the sentence locally, as in a shop offer; excluded because this is an offer made in an e-mail, and until ... is a deadline. B is located kept. Self band hard by 8.3 (L, D, B), lower edge.
notes.r-p7-05:2: Key B relied on outdated departure details. Self band hard (L, D, B, S).

Near-correct B cheese-making demonstration: the review praises it most, but it is the replacement stop and 'the surprise of the day'. C and D are neighbouring itinerary rows that ran as planned. Self band hard (L, D, S).
notes.r-p7-05:4: Key D receiving a full refund (NOT). Near-correct: D itself is the trap in reverse: the full refund is offered in the e-mail para 4, but she travelled anyway and got a voucher. The three mentioned items are paraphrased (sister -> relative; bought two wedges -> buying a product; starving when they sat down at the inn -> hungry before a meal), so each must be found. Self band hard (L, D, B, S).
